originals.citation: Baldassarri, M., Picchiotti, N., Fava, F., et al. (2021). Shorter androgen receptor polyQ alleles protect against life-threatening COVID-19 disease in European males. EBioMedicine, 65, 103246.

quote: A number of ≥23 CAG repeats was significantly associated with a more severe COVID‐19 outcome in an initial cohort of 638 Italian male and female patients; these results were replicated in an independent cohort of 158 Spanish male patients under 60 years of age.
notes: Read the published Andrology version (PMC10098487); the association tested is that of reference 8, Baldassarri et al. 2021.
